Hero.label: About Pawth
Hero.title: Pawth
Hero.lead: A small journaling app for recording one entry a day
Hero.description: Pawth is a journaling app designed to visualize your daily journey and help you commit to today's reflection.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: See your daily journey at a glance and visualize your posting rhythm.

list.title: Journal List
list.description: A list view designed to make past entries easy to revisit and reflect on.

modal.title: Journal Entry Modal
modal.description: A simple one-entry-per-day experience that makes daily journaling easy.

Concept.label: Concept
Concept.title: The Goal Is to Commit to Who You Are Today

onePost.title: One Entry per Day
onePost.description: Limiting daily entries gives each record more meaning.

noDeleteToday.title: No Deleting on the Same Day
noDeleteToday.description: Today's entry remains as a commitment to yourself for that day.

editLimit.title: Up to Three Edits
editLimit.description: Encourages reflection while preventing endless revisions.

deleteLater.title: Delete from the Next Day Onward
deleteLater.description: Leaves room to reorganize entries after giving yourself time to reflect.
